What these six metrics mean

Mentions
Times your brand is named in an answer, with or without a link.
Share of voice
Your citation share versus the whole category.
AI crawls
Visits from AI crawlers to your site per day.
Referrals
Visits arriving from AI answer links per week.
Readiness
Composite GEO Readiness Score, 0–100, unweighted mean of four dimensions.

01 · The shift

Search stopped sending clicks. It started giving answers.

Generative engines skip the links and answer directly, citing a handful of sources. If you're not one of them, you're invisible at the moment your buyer decides. GEO layers on top of SEO — the same credible content that ranks also gets quoted, when it's engineered for it.

40%
Visibility lift from GEO tactics
Statistics, citations and quotations lift AI visibility up to ~40%. PRINCETON, KDD 2024
Mechanism · no published figure
Cross-platform compounding
Being cited on several engines appears to raise the odds of being cited again — models weight agreement across sources. We have no citable study for the size of that effect, so we publish the mechanism and no number. MECHANISM, NOT MEASUREMENT
Mechanism · no published figure
Brand demand beats backlinks
Brand-search demand looks like a stronger citation predictor than link volume. Same caveat: we can describe the direction, not quantify it, so we state it as a mechanism. MECHANISM, NOT MEASUREMENT

03 · Method

Five moves, ranked by leverage.

1

Definitional pillar

Own the quotable definition of your category.

2

Technical access

Server-render, schema, robots rules — crawlers must see it.

3

Answer-first copy

Self-contained answers, dated claims, cited sources.

4

Off-site citations

G2, Reddit, Wikipedia, roundups — the biggest lever.

5

Demonstrate

Publish the score. Prove the method on your own site.

04 · Readiness
Prove, don't claim

We publish our own GEO Readiness Score.

A GEO agency whose own site scores badly is the easiest objection a prospect can raise. So we scored ourselves against our published methodology — live, with provenance. Scores read like a market index: a fixed, versioned prompt panel, the same methodology every run, so movement is comparable. You'll get the same scorecard for your domain.

06 · Ways in

Start free. Stay measured. Go deep when it matters.

Every engagement begins with the same free scorecard — no sales call, no credit card. From there, the subscription keeps your score moving, and the deep audit puts human judgment on the hardest problems.

On timing, plainly: engines re-crawl and re-rank on their own schedules, so shipped work shows up in the numbers weeks after it lands — typically four to eight, sometimes not at all for a given prompt. We report the lag as lag and never present an engine's own update as movement we caused.
